column1: # macOS startup apps -- source of truth for scripts/macos/check-login-items.sh
# The apps that should launch at login, i.e. the "Open at Login" entries under
# System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions. Deliberately out of
# scope: helper login items apps register for themselves (1Password, Docker),
# launchd agents in ~/Library/LaunchAgents, and app extensions (Quick Look,
# Spotlight importers, dock tiles, background app refresh).
# Columns, tab-separated: bundle_id, name, app_path, install
# bundle_id is the match key -- stable across renames and localisation.
# install records how the app gets onto a machine; it is hand-maintained and
# --capture preserves it, defaulting new entries to "unknown".
# Regenerate from the current machine:  check-login-items.sh --capture
